verdict.rationale: Docs show in-platform creation of Convertible Notes with generative workflows and e-signature, and cap table auto-links to documents, supporting the core loop of creating, signing, and reflecting instruments on the cap table. However, there is no explicit mention of SAFEs (only convertible/bridge notes) or of automatic conversion-term modeling into the cap table upon a triggering event. Missing for 10: SAFE instrument support, explicit conversion-term modeling/automation, independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
